description: This file defines database schema, setup, migration, and plugin logic for the Notesnook project, including schema types, database initialization, and a custom plugin for boolean handling in SQLite.

classes.name: SqliteBooleanPlugin
classes.description: A Kysely plugin that transforms boolean values to integers in SQLite queries and results, and applies custom data mappers.

classes.name: SqliteBooleanTransformer
classes.description: Transforms query values and result rows to handle boolean serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: setupDatabase
methods.description: Configures SQLite PRAGMA settings based on provided options.

methods.name: initializeDatabase
methods.description: Runs database migrations and setup, handling errors and logging.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Kysely database instance with optional migration and initialization.

methods.name: changeDatabasePassword
methods.description: Changes the encryption key of the SQLite database.

methods.name: isFalse
methods.description: Creates an expression to check if a column is false or null.
